convoLines.text: "Well. I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."
"I buried this before the Scattering. Seemed stupid to keep it secret." Chloe digs up a wrapped bundle — food, still good. (+1807 kcal to the pantry.)
The ground remembers.
Names, named.
You watch who eats with whom, who laughs a little too loud at whose jokes. Nothing solid. Keep looking.
You say nothing. The silence sits at the fire with everyone else.
The moot is called. The fire gets built up.
Counted.
"Well. My social battery is officially dead."
You don't answer. The quiet turns pointed.
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet. That's the priority."
"Help me haul something back? Too much for one."
Mere has been stockpiling where nobody looks. "Take half. You've got the hands for it." (+4 wood, +4 fiber to the village stash.)
"Heh. Nobody's asked me that in a while. ...I'm alright. Getting there."
"I wish there was more to tell. That's it."
"...Anyway. Sorry. What's on your mind?"
"Asher is gone and Hermann is gone. The fire doesn't care. That's what gets me — the fire doesn't care."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"Okay I really have to move now or I'll explode — talk soon!"
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"We never finished talking about grief — we left it mid-thought, 4 days back. 'You don't answer. The quiet turns pointed.' It'll pass."
"Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."
Chloe shows you where they go to think. "Don't tell the others. Everyone needs one place."
The ground remembers.
Names, named.
You watch who eats with whom, who laughs a little too loud at whose jokes. Nothing solid. Keep looking.
The moot is called. The fire gets built up.
You say nothing. The silence sits at the fire with everyone else.
Counted.
"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
"And... scene. Good talk."
"Right. Well." That's the whole goodbye.
"Why do you ask? We never finished talking about grief — we wandered off it, 4 days back. '...Anyway. Sorry. What's on your mind?' We still owe what's been happening a proper ending, too."
"All right. Thank you for asking."
Something in them almost softens — then doesn't. Not yet.
A long exhale. "I'll get there. Just needed a minute where I didn't have to be fine."
"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
"I — yeah. It helps, hearing that."
"Still on grief. You'd know about that."
"Long story. ...Maybe another time."
"Moving! But — good talk! More later!"
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Good — grief, settled. Feels better said out loud."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"We never did finish talking about what's been happening — that was 11 days back. Still on your mind? 'They fill the quiet. Anyway — where was I?'"
"There's more, but that's for another fire."
"I pace while thinking. It passes the time. The time passes anyway."
"Same as always: we endure."
"Still on what's been happening."
"Okay. We'll pick this up later."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"This was good." They mean it.
"We never finished talking about grief — we left it mid-thought, 7 days back. 'And... scene. Good talk.'"
Chloe has an edge today — something curdled.
"Most days I don't think about it. Today I am. Appreciate you noticing."
"That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."
"Sorry — I got lost in it for a second. What did you want to ask?"
"Good question." "They took me. Bring Us Something Interesting — up there, on the screens, in front of everyone. I'm still turning it over."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
"Still on what's been happening."
You show them Wild Strawberry — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
"Sure. I'll be around."
"Hm. Never mind — go on."

deathBeat: d10: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Asher Murphy is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d10: 🕯️ Asher Murphy is dead — a hushwolf. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
recoverHome: d11: That night, they bring Asher home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
